title: GEO vs SEO
caption:

caption:

title: What Is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)?
caption:
Search is answered now, not listed. AEO is how you make your page THE answer — the featured snippet, the People Also Ask box, the AI Overview summary. Four moves: answer first, question-shaped headings, FAQ/QAPage schema, capture the slot. Fastest way into AI search.
